_doc: Catalogue of interactive figure types. Authors write ':::widget <type>' blocks with 'key: value' lines; tools/build.js validates them against this file. Param types: expr (expression in 'vars', plus slider names), exprs (';'-separated exprs), cexpr (complex expression in z), num (number or constant expression like pi/2), int, bool, range ('min, max'), enum (one of 'values'), str, list (';'-separated strings), points ('x,y; x,y'), sliders ('a=1:-3:3:0.1; b=…' = value:min:max[:step]), matrix ('a,b; c,d' rows separated by ';'). Every type also accepts 'title' (str) and 'caption' (inline markup, shown under the figure).

plot.title: Function plotter
plot.desc: Graphs of one or more functions of x with optional parameter sliders, shading, marked points and a draggable tangent.

f.desc: functions of x separated by ';' (sliders' names may appear)

labels.desc: legend labels (TeX allowed), one per function

shade.desc: shade under the first function between these x values

between.desc: with shade: fill between the first two functions instead

tangent.desc: x0: draggable tangent line to the first function

plot.example:
f: sin(a*x); a*x
sliders: a=1:0.2:3
x: -2pi, 2pi
piticks: true
plot.zh_desc: 一个或多个关于 x 的函数图像，可加参数滑块、阴影、标记点和可拖动的切线。

riemann.title: Riemann sums
riemann.desc: Rectangles (or trapezoids / Simpson parabolas) approximating the integral of f on [a, b]; slider for n; compares with the exact value.
riemann.example:
f: sin(x) + 1
a: 0
b: pi
n: 6
method: mid
riemann.zh_desc: 用矩形（或梯形、辛普森抛物线）近似 f 在 [a, b] 上的积分；可调节 n，并与精确值比较。

sequence.title: Sequences and series
sequence.desc: Terms a_n and/or partial sums S_n; optional ε-band around a limit showing the N from the definition of convergence.
sequence.zh_desc: 数列的项 aₙ 和/或部分和 Sₙ；可在极限附近画出 ε 带，显示收敛定义中的 N。

newton.title: Root finding
newton.desc: Newton's method, the secant method, bisection or fixed-point iteration, step by step with an iteration table.
newton.zh_desc: 逐步演示牛顿法、割线法、二分法或不动点迭代，并给出迭代表。

cobweb.title: Iteration and cobweb plot
cobweb.desc: Cobweb diagram for x_{n+1} = g(x_n) with the orbit; optional bifurcation diagram over a slider parameter.

bifurcation.desc: name of a slider parameter: add a bifurcation diagram over its range

cobweb.example:
g: r*x*(1-x)
sliders: r=2.8:1:4:0.01
x0: 0.2
bifurcation: r
cobweb.zh_desc: xₙ₊₁ = g(xₙ) 的蛛网图及其轨道；可选按滑块参数绘制分岔图。

rowreduce.title: Row reduction
rowreduce.desc: Gaussian elimination of an (augmented) matrix to reduced row echelon form, one elementary row operation per step, with exact fractions.

augmented.desc: true: a bar before the last column ([A | b]); false: no bar; a number k: the bar after column k (e.g. 3 for [A | I] with A 3×3 — the read-out then gives A⁻¹)

rowreduce.zh_desc: 把（增广）矩阵用高斯消元化为简化行阶梯形，每一步一个初等行变换，使用精确分数。

surface.title: Surfaces in 3D
surface.desc: Rotatable surface z = f(x, y) or parametric surface (fx, fy, fz)(u, v), with optional contours, tangent plane and curvature colouring.

tangent.desc: point 'x,y' for a tangent plane (graphs only)

surface.example:
f: x^2 - y^2
contours: true
tangent: 0.5, 0.5
surface.zh_desc: 可旋转的曲面 z = f(x, y) 或参数曲面，可选等高线、切平面和曲率着色。

contour.title: Level curves and gradients
contour.desc: Contour map of f(x, y) with a draggable point showing the gradient and directional derivative; optional constraint g(x, y) = 0 for Lagrange multipliers.

constraint.desc: g(x, y): draws g = 0 and the points where ∇f ∥ ∇g

contour.zh_desc: f(x, y) 的等值线图，可拖动的点显示梯度和方向导数；可加约束 g(x, y) = 0 演示拉格朗日乘数法。

gradientdescent.title: Gradient descent
gradientdescent.desc: Iterates of gradient descent (or momentum / Newton) on the contour map of f, with learning-rate slider and loss curve.
gradientdescent.zh_desc: 在 f 的等值线图上演示梯度下降（或动量法、牛顿法）的迭代，可调学习率并显示损失曲线。

slopefield.title: Slope fields
slopefield.desc: Direction field of y' = f(x, y); click to add solution curves; Euler or RK4 with adjustable step.
slopefield.zh_desc: y' = f(x, y) 的方向场；点击即可添加解曲线；可调步长的欧拉法或 RK4。

phaseplane.title: Phase plane
phaseplane.desc: Phase portrait of x' = f(x, y), y' = g(x, y): field, nullclines, equilibria, click-to-add trajectories; for 'matrix' the eigenvalues and type of the origin.

matrix.desc: linear system x' = Ax (instead of f, g); entries get sliders

points.desc: starting points of the trajectories drawn; when given, the automatic orbits (saddle separatrices and seed grid) are not drawn

phaseplane.zh_desc: x' = f(x, y)，y' = g(x, y) 的相图：方向场、零斜线、平衡点，点击添加轨线；矩阵模式显示特征值与原点类型。

odesolver.title: Numerical ODE solvers
odesolver.desc: Euler, Heun and RK4 approximations of y' = f(t, y) against the exact solution, with a step-size slider and the global error.
odesolver.example:
f: y
y0: 1
t: 0, 2
exact: exp(t)
odesolver.zh_desc: 欧拉法、休恩法和 RK4 对 y' = f(t, y) 的近似与精确解比较，可调步长并显示整体误差。

distribution.title: Probability distributions
distribution.desc: PMF/PDF and CDF of a named distribution with parameter sliders, P(a ≤ X ≤ b) shaded, mean ± sd, and an optional normal approximation.

params.desc: initial parameters, e.g. 'n=10, p=0.3' or 'mu=0, sigma=1'

distribution.example:
dist: binomial
params: n=20, p=0.3
a: 4
b: 8
normal: true
distribution.zh_desc: 常见分布的概率质量函数/密度函数和分布函数，带参数滑块、P(a ≤ X ≤ b) 阴影、均值 ± 标准差，可叠加正态近似。

clt.title: Central limit theorem
clt.desc: Histogram of many sample means from a chosen population for sample size n, against the normal curve predicted by the CLT.
clt.zh_desc: 从选定总体中抽取大量样本的样本均值直方图，与中心极限定理预测的正态曲线比较。

lln.title: Law of large numbers
lln.desc: Running averages of independent trials (coin, die or Bernoulli(p)) converging to the mean, several runs at once.
lln.zh_desc: 独立试验（掷硬币、掷骰子或伯努利(p)）的累计平均值收敛到期望，可同时运行多组。

montecarlo.title: Monte Carlo estimation
montecarlo.desc: Random points estimate π or ∫ f; the estimate and its error shrink like 1/√n.
montecarlo.zh_desc: 用随机点估计 π 或 ∫f；估计值的误差按 1/√n 缩小。

markov.title: Markov chains
markov.desc: State diagram of a Markov chain, a simulated walk, the distribution after n steps and the stationary distribution.
markov.zh_desc: 马尔可夫链的状态图、随机游走模拟、n 步后的分布以及平稳分布。

hypothesis.title: Hypothesis tests and power
hypothesis.desc: Null and alternative sampling distributions of a z or t statistic: rejection region, α, β, power and the p-value of an observed value.

effect.desc: true effect size in standard deviations (Cohen's d)

hypothesis.example:
test: z
tail: right
alpha: 0.05
effect: 0.5
n: 25
hypothesis.zh_desc: z 或 t 统计量在原假设和备择假设下的抽样分布：拒绝域、α、β、功效以及观测值的 p 值。

confidence.title: Confidence intervals
confidence.desc: Many simulated confidence intervals for a mean: about the stated level of them cover the true value.
confidence.zh_desc: 大量模拟的均值置信区间：约有设定比例的区间覆盖真值。

bayes.title: Bayesian updating
bayes.desc: Beta prior → posterior for a proportion as successes and failures arrive, or Bayes' theorem for a diagnostic test as natural frequencies.
bayes.zh_desc: 比例的贝塔先验随成功和失败次数更新为后验；或以自然频数展示诊断检验中的贝叶斯定理。

regression.title: Least squares regression
regression.desc: Draggable data points with the least-squares line (or polynomial), residuals, the fitted equation and R².
regression.zh_desc: 可拖动的数据点及其最小二乘直线（或多项式）、残差、拟合方程和 R²。

graph.title: Graphs and graph algorithms
graph.desc: A draggable graph and a step-by-step algorithm: BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, Prim, Kruskal, topological sort, Euler circuit or greedy colouring.
graph.example:
nodes: A; B; C; D; E
edges: A-B:4; A-C:1; C-B:2; B-D:1; C-D:5; D-E:3
algorithm: dijkstra
start: A
graph.zh_desc: 可拖动的图及逐步演示的算法：广度优先、深度优先、迪杰斯特拉、普里姆、克鲁斯卡尔、拓扑排序、欧拉回路或贪心着色。

equity.title: Equity and drawdown
equity.desc: A toy price path you can drag, with the compounded equity index and the drawdown. Preset compare shows two orders of the same four returns.
equity.zh_desc: 可拖动的示意价格路径，以及复利净值与回撤。compare 预设用同一组四个收益率的两种顺序作比较。

preset.desc: a Path A, b Path B, c and d the two orders in the drawdown proof, compare draws c and d together

compound.title: Two-step compounding
compound.desc: Two simple returns, the sum, the compound growth, and the sum of the log returns.
compound.zh_desc: 两个简单收益率，以及它们的和、复利增长与对数收益率之和。

candles.title: OHLC bars
candles.desc: Toy open-high-low-close bars. The group size merges consecutive sessions into one bar.
candles.zh_desc: 示意的开高低收。分组大小把连续的时段合并成一根 K 线。

average.title: Two moving averages
average.desc: A fast and a slow average on one wavy toy path. Shading marks where the fast average is above the slow one.
average.zh_desc: 一条波动的示意路径上的快慢两条平均线。阴影表示快线在慢线之上的日期。

bands.title: Rolling band
bands.desc: A rolling mean and a band of k sample standard deviations on a toy mean-reverting path.
bands.zh_desc: 示意的均值回归路径上的滚动均值，以及 k 倍样本标准差的通道。

barlimit.title: Limit on a bar
barlimit.desc: Drag a limit across eight toy bars. Under the optimistic range convention the bar fills only when the limit lies between its low and its high.
barlimit.zh_desc: 在八根示意 K 线上拖动限价。在乐观的价格区间约定下，只有限价落在最低价与最高价之间才成交。

stop.title: Stop on one bar
stop.zh: 止损与单根 K 线
stop.desc: One toy bar and the chapter’s stop-market and stop-limit rules, including a gap through the trigger.
stop.zh_desc: 一根示意 K 线，以及本章的止损市价与止损限价规则，包括跳空穿过触发价的情形。
stop.example:
open: 90
high: 94
low: 88
close: 91
trigger: 95
limit: 93
kind: sell-market

folds.title: Walk-forward windows
folds.desc: Rolling or expanding train and test windows on one line of dates, with an optional label purge and embargo.
folds.zh_desc: 同一条日期上的滚动或扩展训练窗与测试窗，可加标签清洗和禁运。

h.desc: label horizon purged before each test

folds.example:
T: 30
L: 12
H: 6
S: 6
h: 0
m: 0
mode: rolling

weights.title: Inverse-volatility weights
weights.desc: Weights proportional to 1/σ, and the scale that takes the zero-correlation book to a volatility target.
weights.zh_desc: 与 1/σ 成比例的权重，以及把零相关组合波动率调到目标所需的比例。

sharpe.title: Sharpe and its standard error
sharpe.desc: A per-step Sharpe ratio and the Lo 2002 iid-normal standard error. Annualising multiplies both by √252.
sharpe.zh_desc: 逐步夏普比率，以及 Lo 2002 在独立同分布正态假设下的标准误。年化会把两者都乘以 √252。
sharpe.example:
mean: 0.01393
sd: 0.022848
n: 7
rf: 0
annualise: false

payoff.title: Win rate and profit factor
payoff.desc: Path A’s printed simple returns, or a win rate with an average win and an average loss. The profit factor is gains over absolute losses.
payoff.zh_desc: 路径 A 印出的简单收益率，或由胜率、平均盈利与平均亏损算出的盈亏比。盈亏比是盈利合计除以亏损绝对值合计。

spread.title: Hedge ratio and spread
spread.desc: Two invented series. The spread is the second minus a hedge ratio times the first. Its scatter is smallest near the ratio used to build the pair.
spread.zh_desc: 两条虚构序列。价差是第二条减去对冲比率乘以第一条。离散程度在构造这对序列所用的比率附近最小。

formation.title: Formation and skip
formation.desc: A formation window and a skip on a toy path. The signal is the simple return across the formation window only.
formation.zh_desc: 示意路径上的形成期与跳过区间。信号只用来自形成期的简单收益率。
